mechanism: Clindamycin may increase chlorpromazine levels through CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inhibition, and both drugs have anticholinergic and CNS depressant properties that may be additive.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine adverse effects including extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, and anticholinergic effects; consider dose adjustment of chlorpromazine if needed.
